sql:
SELECT LTRIM(doc_no,'0') AS doc_no, entry_type, tx_date::date AS tx_date,
           ROUND((amount_excl + tax_amount)::numeric, 2)::float AS amount,
           source_file
    FROM transaction_headers
    WHERE account_no = $1 AND tx_date >= $2::date

           source_file
    FROM transaction_headers
